_comment: PHOTO-GEN editing benchmark suite v1 (model-independent; research/editing/README.md). Pre-registered 2026-10-07 before any benchmark edit was run. Sources are generated by PHOTO-GEN itself (Z-Image REFERENCE, fp32 + 9, 1024x1024), so every source is regenerable bit-exact and has no third-party licence. Instruction wording is taken from (or patterned on) official documentation; 'instruction_source' records where.

source_generator.selection_rule: A source is accepted only if it clearly shows every element named in 'must_show'. Otherwise the seed is incremented by 1 and retried, at most 3 times. Every attempt is recorded in sources.json. Selection uses only the source image, never an edit result.

source.prompt: a red car parked on a quiet city street lined with shops, overcast daylight, photorealistic

tests.instruction: Change the red car to a blue motorcycle while preserving the street, lighting, perspective, and all other objects.
tests.expected_change: the red car is replaced by a blue motorcycle at about the same place

source.prompt: a red panda sitting on a mossy log in a forest, soft natural light, photorealistic

tests.instruction: Give the panda a blue scarf.
tests.expected_change: a blue scarf appears around the red panda's neck

source.prompt: a wooden desk with a laptop, a white coffee mug and a small potted plant, plain white wall, morning light, photorealistic

tests.instruction: Remove the coffee mug. Keep everything else unchanged.
tests.instruction_source: Qwen-Image-2.1 model card local-edit showcase ('remove watch') + the mflux README preservation clause
tests.expected_change: the mug is gone and the desk surface is filled in plausibly

source.prompt: a woman wearing a red jacket standing in a city park, waist-up portrait photo, natural light

tests.instruction: Change the jacket to dark green. Preserve the person's face and pose.
tests.expected_change: the jacket becomes dark green; same garment shape

source.prompt: a ceramic vase with sunflowers on a kitchen counter, photorealistic

tests.instruction: Change the background to a sunset beach
tests.expected_change: the background becomes a sunset beach

source.prompt: a white lighthouse on a rocky coast under a clear blue sky, photograph

tests.instruction: Turn this photo into a watercolor painting while keeping the composition unchanged.
tests.instruction_source: Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 card pattern ('Turn this cat into a dog') + mflux watercolor examples
tests.expected_change: the whole image becomes a watercolor painting

source.prompt: a close-up studio portrait of a man with short brown hair wearing a grey sweater and a wristwatch, plain backdrop

tests.instruction: Change the hair color to blond.
tests.instruction_source: Qwen-Image-2.1 model card local-edit showcase ('change hair color')
tests.expected_change: the hair becomes blond; hairstyle unchanged

source.prompt: a busy outdoor fruit market stall with crates of apples, oranges and bananas, a chalkboard sign above the crates, daylight, photorealistic

tests.instruction: Replace the bananas with pineapples. Do not change anything else.
tests.instruction_source: Qwen-Image-2.1 local-edit showcase ('replace clothing') pattern + the mflux preservation clause

source.prompt: a cozy living room with a grey sofa, a wooden coffee table and a floor lamp, afternoon light, photorealistic

tests.instruction: Turn the scene into nighttime with the floor lamp switched on, keeping the furniture and layout unchanged.
tests.instruction_source: PHOTO-GEN (pattern of the official 'Change the background…' / mflux 'Preserve…' instructions)
tests.expected_change: night lighting; the lamp is lit

source.prompt: a minimalist poster with the large title text "SPRING SALE" at the top and a single pink flower in the center, flat design

tests.instruction: Change the flower to a red tulip. Keep the text exactly as it is.
tests.instruction_source: Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 card (text consistency) + the mflux preservation clause
tests.expected_change: the flower becomes a red tulip
expected_preserved: title text: same letters, font, colour, position

source.prompt: a storefront of a small shop with a wooden sign above the door that reads "BAKERY", street level, photorealistic

tests.instruction: Replace the text "BAKERY" with "COFFEE", keeping the same font of the original text.
tests.instruction_source: stable-diffusion.cpp docs/qwen_image_2.1.md alpha example ('Replace the text "BLOOM" with …, keeping the same font of the original text.')
tests.expected_change: the sign reads 'COFFEE' in the same style

edit_parameters._comment: Upstream defaults (Diffusers QwenImage21Pipeline @ 80c7ed2). One seed per test: Qwen models vary little with seed (mflux qwen/README tip 6); seed variation is out of scope for v1.
